name: esp32-camera-ov2640
description: IDF5/Arduino3 rebase of the lightgun esp32-camera fork (S3+OV2640 only). All LIGHTGUN patches ported 2026-08-06: exact fractional XCLK, streaming chunk callback + loss counters + short-frame tolerance (cam_hal.c wholesale from the IDF4 fork + 3 IDF5 API shims), SCCB read-error flag, OV2640 bank-cache-on-ACK, ll_cam_memcpy honest length. Shadows the Arduino core PREBUILT esp32-camera at link time - verified zero live members from the bundled archive.
